title: Straightening a coefficient field in the standard split node
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[[u,v]], I=(uv), T=S/I, and m=(u,v)T. For any unital ring map $\alpha:k\to T$ such that every z in T is congruent modulo m to alpha(a) for some a in k, there is a ring automorphism e of T satisfying e(alpha(a))=a for every a in k, where the right-hand side is the standard constant-series class. Power series and their ideal quotient are the actual constructions of [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series].

source.place: Tags 0C4D and 0CBW, split-node coefficient-field convention; coefficient substitution argument using adic completeness.

proof.text: The variable-adically complete Noetherian ring S has finite quotient module T. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-module-complete-over-complete-noetherian], T is complete for m. Evaluate power series using alpha on coefficients and the images of u and v on variables by [lem-weil-pbc-power-series-universal-property-complete]. Since uv vanishes in T, this factors through an endomorphism theta:T→T.

proof.text: The image of the source variable ideal under evaluation is m. The residue-surjectivity assumption gives surjectivity modulo that ideal. The complete-source surjectivity criterion (Mathlib surjective_of_mk_map_comp_surjective) makes evaluation surjective, hence theta is surjective.

proof.text: A surjective endomorphism of a Noetherian ring is injective: the increasing ideals ker(theta^n) stabilize; lift x in ker(theta) through theta^n and use stabilization to show x=0. Thus theta is an automorphism. Its inverse sends alpha(a)=theta(a) to the standard constant a.

theorem nodal_coefficient_straightening (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (α : k →+* (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) k ⧸
      Ideal.span {(X 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) k) * X 1}))
    (hα : ∀ z, ∃ a : k, z - α a ∈
      (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : Fin 2 → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) k))).map
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(X 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) k) * X 1}))) :
    ∃ e : (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) k ⧸
        Ideal.span {(X 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) k) * X 1}) ≃+*
        (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) k ⧸
          Ideal.span {(X 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) k) * X 1}),
      ∀ a : k, e (α a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (C a)
